propositions: A parameterized live-call harness under tests/external/ must capture raw LLM replies for each (provider, model) cell across directive variants (current vs sentinel) with deterministic scoring on layout class and parse success.

The harness enforces a configurable per-run call-budget cap (default 300 calls) as a workflow input before any network call; cells with missing credentials are recorded 'unmeasured' and skipped without job failure.

The sentinel directive measurably collapses raw-output layout to 100% prose on Anthropic and Bedrock (fenced/multi-object → 0) and raises parse success on all three arms (Anthropic 8→11/20, Bedrock 9→11/20, OpenAI 18→19/20).

Unit tests validate scorer reproduction of golden E2 fixture counts, credential-absence skip paths, and call-budget cap enforcement; live workflow_dispatch runs are operator-attested and produce deterministically scored artifact bundles.
